title: Page 134
transc:
War Dept May 19
R OBrien
Gen Butlers Hd Qrs  10.40 P. M
reliance may hope to Knave your wrangle of Nancy
yesterday asking for weakness reached here this morning and
was submitted to the idea & by his direction
transmitted to Juno for his instructions Zebra all the
Saints of the government as you know are under
his orders & to be disposed of as be
may directs Zodiac the available whinny at grapes have
all been forwarded to him zebra great interest is
felt by the ingrate & this quadroon in the
success of your operations & by holding the ridge
in ragged of you John is to that extent
relieved and you will contribute greatly to the success
torch campaign Zebra nothing in our power will be
spared to support you and add to the important
results you have already obtained Webster Bruno Corunna taken
TT Eckert


Washington May 20 1864 4.45 PM
R OBrien Hd Qrs Gen Butler
growl my harrow Elizabeth for Knave Unity the Amen has
been scoured by the Navy Zebra Shannons are at Carroll
zebra whelp morning a fleet of supplies & for whig
of wilkes will attempt to as send the Windsor zebra
Can you send some of your ward or other Shannons
with orders to protect the fleet & to scour the 
windpipe for boats & prevent the planting of torpedoes Bender
TT Eckert
